task: You are now playing a fast paced game of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First thing I need you to do is to venture west. And then, look and see that the door is wide open. And then, go to the south. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. Then, head east. After that, attempt to take a trip east. And then, take a trip north. Then, recover the folder from the floor of the workshop. Got that? Good!
